Name: Timid's Home - Brick and Spruce
Author: Timidx3
Description:
[font=Georgia]Hi everyone! I'm Timid, and thisss is my home!
I was never a huge fan of the default house, so I've
spent more time than I'd like to admit making one
that suited my personal style a bit more. I've used what
I could from existing game files as I'm clearly not a
pixel artist, so somethings I made myself are a bit 
derpy and I apologize. I did what I could! I hope
someone else can enjoy my creation aswell! c:

Feel free to checkout my thread on the Stardew
Valley forums aswell! [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/timids-home-brick-spruce-10-15-2016.110461/][Click Me!][/url]

[/font][font=Georgia]I've also included downloads for a matching
stable that lines up perfectly with the roof, 
along with a greenhouse edit that matches
better than the defualt did. Credit to Maleha 
from the Stardew Valley forums for the original
greenhouse and stable images. Check out their
thread [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/a-whole-bunch-of-things-pets-paths-stable-etc.111044/#post-2852650]here![/url] 
[/font]
